people.name: Aksakalov Kumar Irgibayevich
people.position: Mayor of Kostanay region

people.generalInfoHtml: Kumar Irgibayevich Aksakalov was born in 1965. In 1987, he graduated from the V.P. Goryachkina Moscow Institute of Agricultural Engineers, mechanical engineer. PhD in Economics.
people.careerHistoryHtml:
1987-1989 — Chief Engineer of state farm "Krylovskiy" of Uritsky district of Kostanay region.

1989-1992 — First Secretary of Uritsky District Committee of the LYCL of Kazakhstan of Kostanay region.

1992-1993 — Chief Engineer of state farm "Mayak" of Uritsky district of Kostanay region.

1993-1994 — Director of small state enterprise "Novosyolovka" of Kostanay district of Kostanay region.

1994-1996 — Deputy General Director of research and production association "Kostanayskoye" of Kostanay district of Kostanay region.

1996-1998 — Chairman of collective farm "Sever", President of JSC "Sever" Mendikara district of Kostanay region.

1998-2002 — mayor of Mendikara district of Kostanay region.

2002-2004 — mayor of Taran district of Kostanay region.

2004-2006 — State inspector of State Control and Organizational unit of the Administration of the President of the Republic of Kazakhstan.

2006-2010 — Deputy mayor of Zhambyl region.

2010-2015 — Head of Central Office of the People's Democratic Party "Nur Otan", secretary of party "Nur Otan".

2015-2017 — Deputy Head of the Presidential Administration of the Republic of Kazakhstan.

March 14, 2017 - November 30, 2022 — mayor of North Kazakhstan region.

On December 1, 2022, he was appointed mayor of Kostanay region.

Job responsibilities:

Organizes the implementation of laws of the Republic of Kazakhstan, decrees of the President of the Republic of Kazakhstan, and other acts of higher government bodies in the region, and interacts with the Government of the Republic of Kazakhstan on matters related to the functioning of the region's national economic complex. Organizes and oversees the implementation of the Kazakhstan-2030 and Kazakhstan-2050 strategies. Implements human resources policy. Takes measures to combat corruption.
Ensures the implementation of state policy and is responsible for the socio-economic development of the region.

Coordinates the work of:
Deputy Akims of the region, city and district akimats, and akims.

Supervises:
The Internal Audit Service of the State Institution "Office of the Akim of Kostanay Region."

Manages the activities of:
the regional Akimat,
the interdepartmental commission for crime prevention under the regional Akimat,
the regional crisis response headquarters of Kostanay Oblast,
the anti-terrorism commission under the regional Akimat,
the commission on combating corruption under the regional Akimat,
the commission for the prevention and response to emergency situations.

Interacts:
at the national level with:
the Presidential Administration, the Government Office, and ministries;
At the local level, with:
Kostanay Region Prosecutor's Office,
Kostanay Region Department of the National Security Committee of the Republic of Kazakhstan,
Kostanay Region Police Department of the Ministry of Internal Affairs of the Republic of Kazakhstan,
Kostanay Region Defense Department of the Ministry of Defense of the Republic of Kazakhstan,
Kostanay Region Emergency Situations Department of the Ministry of Emergency Situations of the Republic of Kazakhstan,
Kostanay Region Department of Justice of the Ministry of Justice of the Republic of Kazakhstan,
Kostanay Region Department of the Agency of the Republic of Kazakhstan for Civil Service Affairs,
Kostanay Region Department of the Anti-Corruption Agency of the Republic of Kazakhstan (Anti-Corruption Service) of the Republic of Kazakhstan,
Kostanay Region Department of the Penitentiary System of the Ministry of Internal Affairs of the Republic of Kazakhstan.
Performs other duties in accordance with legislation.

generalInfoBlocksZh.text: 库马尔·伊尔吉巴耶维奇·阿克萨卡洛夫 (Kumar Irgibayevich Aksakalov) 出生于 1965 年。1987 年毕业于副教授。 Goryachkina 莫斯科农业工程师学院，机械工程师。经济学博士。
generalInfoBlocksZh.sourceText: Kumar Irgibayevich Aksakalov was born in 1965. In 1987, he graduated from the V.P. Goryachkina Moscow Institute of Agricultural Engineers, mechanical engineer. PhD in Economics.

careerHistoryBlocksZh.text: 1987年至1989年 — 科斯塔奈地区乌里茨基区国营农场“Krylovskiy”总工程师。
careerHistoryBlocksZh.sourceText: 1987-1989 — Chief Engineer of state farm "Krylovskiy" of Uritsky district of Kostanay region.

careerHistoryBlocksZh.text: 1989年至1992年 — 哈萨克斯坦科斯塔奈地区列宁共产主义青年联盟乌里茨基地区委员会第一书记。
careerHistoryBlocksZh.sourceText: 1989-1992 — First Secretary of Uritsky District Committee of the LYCL of Kazakhstan of Kostanay region.

careerHistoryBlocksZh.text: 1992年至1993年 — 科斯塔奈地区乌里茨基区国营农场“Mayak”的总工程师。
careerHistoryBlocksZh.sourceText: 1992-1993 — Chief Engineer of state farm "Mayak" of Uritsky district of Kostanay region.

careerHistoryBlocksZh.text: 1993年至1994年 — 科斯塔奈地区科斯塔奈区小型国有企业“Novosyolovka”董事。
careerHistoryBlocksZh.sourceText: 1993-1994 — Director of small state enterprise "Novosyolovka" of Kostanay district of Kostanay region.

careerHistoryBlocksZh.text: 1994年至1996年 — 科斯塔奈地区科斯塔奈区研究和生产协会“Kostanayskoye”副总经理。
careerHistoryBlocksZh.sourceText: 1994-1996 — Deputy General Director of research and production association "Kostanayskoye" of Kostanay district of Kostanay region.

careerHistoryBlocksZh.text: 1996-1998 年 — 集体农场“Sever”主席、科斯塔奈 地区门迪卡拉区“Sever”股份公司 总裁。
careerHistoryBlocksZh.sourceText: 1996-1998 — Chairman of collective farm "Sever", President of JSC "Sever" Mendikara district of Kostanay region.

careerHistoryBlocksZh.text: 1998-2002 年 — 科斯塔奈地区门迪卡拉区区长。
careerHistoryBlocksZh.sourceText: 1998-2002 — mayor of Mendikara district of Kostanay region.

careerHistoryBlocksZh.text: 2002年至2004年 — 科斯塔奈地区塔兰区区长。
careerHistoryBlocksZh.sourceText: 2002-2004 — mayor of Taran district of Kostanay region.

careerHistoryBlocksZh.text: 2004-2006 年 — 哈萨克斯坦共和国总统办公厅国家控制和组织单位国家监察员。
careerHistoryBlocksZh.sourceText: 2004-2006 — State inspector of State Control and Organizational unit of the Administration of the President of the Republic of Kazakhstan.

careerHistoryBlocksZh.text: 2006年至2010年任江布尔州副市长。
careerHistoryBlocksZh.sourceText: 2006-2010 — Deputy mayor of Zhambyl region.

careerHistoryBlocksZh.text: 2010年至2015年 — 人民民主党“努尔·奥坦”中央办公厅主任、“努尔·奥坦”党委书记。
careerHistoryBlocksZh.sourceText: 2010-2015 — Head of Central Office of the People's Democratic Party "Nur Otan", secretary of party "Nur Otan".

careerHistoryBlocksZh.text: 2015 年至 2017 年 — 哈萨克斯坦共和国总统办公厅副主任。
careerHistoryBlocksZh.sourceText: 2015-2017 — Deputy Head of the Presidential Administration of the Republic of Kazakhstan.

careerHistoryBlocksZh.text: 2017年3月14日至2022年11月30日——北哈萨克斯坦地区市长。
careerHistoryBlocksZh.sourceText: March 14, 2017 - November 30, 2022 — mayor of North Kazakhstan region.

careerHistoryBlocksZh.text: 2022年12月1日，他被任命为科斯塔奈州市长。
careerHistoryBlocksZh.sourceText: On December 1, 2022, he was appointed mayor of Kostanay region.

careerHistoryBlocksZh.text: 组织实施哈萨克斯坦共和国法律、哈萨克斯坦共和国总统法令以及本地区高级政府机构的其他行为，并就与本地区国家经济综合体运作有关的事务与哈萨克斯坦共和国政府进行互动。组织并监督《哈萨克斯坦2030年》和《哈萨克斯坦2050年战略》的实施。落实人力资源政策。采取措施打击腐败。

Organizes and oversees the implementation of the Kazakhstan-2030 and Kazakhstan-2050 strategies. Implements human resources policy. Takes measures to combat corruption.

1. Ensures:
- the timely, high-quality, and complete implementation of state policy and regional programs in the areas of agriculture, land relations, veterinary medicine, livestock farming, crop production, entrepreneurship, tourism, investment, industrial and innovative development, mobilization training, and territorial and civil defense in the Kostanay region;
- the timely, high-quality, and complete implementation of acts and instructions of the President of the Republic of Kazakhstan, the Prime Minister of the Republic of Kazakhstan, the Presidential Administration of the Republic of Kazakhstan, the State Advisor of the Republic of Kazakhstan, the Government Office of the Republic of Kazakhstan, and acts and instructions of the Akim and Akimat of Kostanay region;
- interaction with the Presidential Administration of the Republic of Kazakhstan, the Government Office of the Republic of Kazakhstan, central government bodies of the Republic of Kazakhstan and their territorial divisions, and other government bodies and institutions;
- coordination of draft laws, government decrees, orders of the Prime Minister, presidential decrees, appeals, cassation appeals, and private complaints in supervised areas.

2. Organizes:
- development of the agro-industrial complex to achieve a qualitatively new level of competitiveness in its sectors, including livestock farming and crop production;
- land resource management and regulation of land relations;
- veterinary and sanitary security;
- development of entrepreneurship, domestic trade, tourism, investment attraction, and implementation of industrial and innovative projects in the region;
- ensuring mobilization readiness and territorial defense.

3. Coordinates:
- interaction between territorial bodies in the implementation of programs and comprehensive measures in agriculture, land relations, veterinary medicine, livestock farming, crop production, entrepreneurship, tourism, investment, industrial and innovative development, mobilization preparation, and territorial and civil defense;
- interaction with quasi-public sector organizations, business entities, international and public organizations, foundations, and other enterprises within the scope of assigned powers. 

4. Manages:
- structural divisions of the Akimat implementing work in the areas of agriculture, land relations, veterinary medicine, livestock farming, crop production, entrepreneurship, tourism, investment, industrial and innovative development, mobilization preparation, territorial and civil defense.

5. Heads territorial advisory and coordinating councils and commissions (within the scope of assigned powers).

- 兽医和卫生安全；
- 发展创业、国内贸易、旅游业、招商引资以及实施该地区的工业和创新项目；
- 确保动员准备和领土防御。

- 领土机构之间在执行农业、土地关系、兽医、畜牧业、作物生产、创业、旅游、投资、工业和创新发展、动员准备以及领土和民防方面的方案和综合措施方面的互动；
- 在授权范围内与准公共部门组织、商业实体、国际和公共组织、基金会和其他企业进行互动。
4. 管理：
- 农业、土地关系、兽医、畜牧业、农作物生产、创业、旅游、投资、工业和创新发展、动员准备、领土和民防等领域开展工作的行政机关结构部门。
5. 领导地区咨询和协调理事会和委员会（在指定的权力范围内）。

people.name: Taszhurekov Yerbol Kuanyshevich
people.position: Deputy mayor of Kostanay region
people.workScopeZh: 医疗卫生、财政和预算
people.generalInfoHtml:
By order of the regional akim, Yerbol Taszhurekov Kuanyshevich has been appointed as the deputy akim of the Kostanay region. Previously, he held the position of Vice Minister of Agriculture of the Republic of Kazakhstan.

Born in 1979 in the city of Taraz.

Has education in the following specialties:

  • economist;
  • lawyer;
  • Master of State and Local Administration;
  • Master of Public Administration and International Relations.

Graduated from:

  • M.Kh. Dulaty Taraz State University;
  • Khoja Akhmet Yassawi International Kazakh-Turkish University;
  • Academy of Public Administration under the President of the Republic of Kazakhstan;
  • National School of Administration of France.

Work Experience

  • 1998–2001 — currency exchange office manager at TOO "Kaznur";
  • 2003–2007 — director of TOO "Profile-Lux";
  • 2007–2013 — worked in various positions at District Court No. 2 of the Almaty District of Astana;
  • 2013–2014 — held managerial positions in the Ministry of Regional Development of the Republic of Kazakhstan;
  • 2014–2016 — deputy director of the department of the Ministry of National Economy of the Republic of Kazakhstan;
  • 2016–2018 — deputy chairman of the Investment Committee of the Ministry for Investment and Development of the Republic of Kazakhstan;
  • 2018–2019 — deputy akim of the South Kazakhstan region;
  • 2019–2021 — managing director – member of the Board of JSC "National Management Holding "KazAgro";
  • 2023–2026 — Vice Minister of Agriculture of the Republic of Kazakhstan.
people.careerHistoryHtml:
1. Ensures:

- timely, high-quality, and complete implementation of state policy and regional programs in the areas of economics, budget planning, finance, public procurement, municipal property and housing management, healthcare, employment coordination, and social programs in the Kostanay region;

- timely, high-quality, and complete implementation of acts and instructions of the President of the Republic of Kazakhstan, the Prime Minister of the Republic of Kazakhstan, the Presidential Administration of the Republic of Kazakhstan, the State Counselor of the Republic of Kazakhstan, the Government Office of the Republic of Kazakhstan, and acts and instructions of the Akim and Akimat of Kostanay region;

- interaction with the Presidential Administration of the Republic of Kazakhstan, the Government Office of the Republic of Kazakhstan, central government bodies of the Republic of Kazakhstan and their territorial divisions, and other government agencies and institutions;

- coordination of draft laws, government decrees, orders of the Prime Minister, presidential decrees, appeals, cassation appeals, and private complaints in areas of responsibility.

2. Organizes:

- draft budget development, timely and high-quality planning, facilitating the effective implementation of socio-economic development priorities;

- budget planning and execution;

- municipal property and housing management;

- public procurement, interaction with the authorized body, the single operator for public procurement, and state audit and financial control bodies;

- labor market development, implementation of measures to promote employment and reduce unemployment;

- provision of specialized social services, coordination of the activities of healthcare organizations in the field of specialized social services in healthcare, as well as other social and labor measures in accordance with the legislation of the Republic of Kazakhstan;

- provision of high-quality and accessible medical services, health protection, and the promotion of a healthy lifestyle.

3. Coordinates:

- interaction between territorial bodies in the implementation of programs and comprehensive measures in the areas of economics, budget planning, finance, public procurement, municipal property and housing management, healthcare, and employment and social program coordination;

- interaction with quasi-public sector organizations, business entities, international and public organizations, foundations, and other enterprises within the scope of assigned powers.

4. Manages:

- structural divisions of the Akimat implementing work in the areas of economics, budget planning, finance, public procurement, municipal property and housing management, healthcare, and employment and social program coordination.

5. Heads territorial advisory and coordinating councils and commissions (within the scope of assigned powers).

法国国家行政学院。
1998–2001 — 有限责任合伙企业“Kaznur”货币兑换办公室经理；

2007年至2013年——在阿斯塔纳阿拉木图区第二地方法院担任多个职务；
2013年至2014年——在哈萨克斯坦共和国区域发展部担任管理职务；
2014年至2016年——哈萨克斯坦共和国国民经济部副司长；
2016年至2018年——哈萨克斯坦共和国投资和发展部投资委员会副主席；
2018年至2019年——南哈萨克斯坦州副州长；
2019–2021 — 董事总经理 — “国家管理控股”KazAgro”股份公司董事会成员；
2023 年至 2026 年 — 哈萨克斯坦共和国农业部副部长。

1979 年出生于塔拉兹市。

工作经验
people.careerHistoryZh:
1. 确保：
- 及时、高质量、全面执行科斯塔奈州经济、预算规划、金融、公共采购、市政财产和住房管理、医疗保健、就业协调和社会项目等领域的国家政策和区域计划；
- 及时、高质量和全面执行哈萨克斯坦共和国总统、哈萨克斯坦共和国总理、哈萨克斯坦共和国总统办公厅、哈萨克斯坦共和国国务资政、哈萨克斯坦共和国政府办公厅的法令和指示以及科斯塔奈州行政长官和行政公署的法令和指示；
- 与哈萨克斯坦共和国总统办公厅、哈萨克斯坦共和国政府办公室、哈萨克斯坦共和国中央政府机构及其领土部门以及其他政府机构和机构进行互动；
- 协调责任领域的法律草案、政府法令、总理命令、总统法令、上诉、撤销原判上诉和私人投诉。
2. 组织：
- 起草预算制定、及时和高质量的规划，促进社会经济发展优先事项的有效实施；
- 预算规划和执行；
- 市政财产和住房管理；
- 公共采购、与授权机构、公共采购单一运营商以及国家审计和财务控制机构的互动；
- 劳动力市场发展，实施促进就业和减少失业的措施；
- 提供专门的社会服务，协调医疗保健组织在医疗保健专门社会服务领域的活动，以及根据哈萨克斯坦共和国法律采取的其他社会和劳动措施；
- 提供优质、便捷的医疗服务、健康保障、倡导健康生活方式。
3、坐标：
- 领土机构之间在实施经济、预算规划、财政、公共采购、市政财产和住房管理、医疗保健、就业和社会方案协调等领域的方案和综合措施方面的互动；
- 在授权范围内与准公共部门组织、商业实体、国际和公共组织、基金会和其他企业进行互动。
4. 管理：
- 行政机关的结构部门在经济、预算规划、金融、公共采购、市政财产和住房管理、医疗保健、就业和社会计划协调等领域开展工作。
5. 领导地区咨询和协调理事会和委员会（在指定的权力范围内）。

  1. Ensures:

the timely, high-quality, and complete implementation of state policy and regional programs in the areas of domestic policy (social development), culture, information, education, science, sports, youth policy, religion, and language development in the Kostanay region;
- the timely, high-quality, and complete implementation of acts and instructions of the President of the Republic of Kazakhstan, the Prime Minister of the Republic of Kazakhstan, the Administration of the President of the Republic of Kazakhstan, the State Counselor of the Republic of Kazakhstan, the Executive Office of the Government of the Republic of Kazakhstan, and acts and instructions of the Akim and Akimat of Kostanay region;
- interaction with the Administration of the President of the Republic of Kazakhstan, the Executive Office of the Government of the Republic of Kazakhstan, central government bodies of the Republic of Kazakhstan and their territorial divisions, and other government bodies and institutions;
- coordination of draft laws, government decrees, orders of the Prime Minister, acts of the President, appeals, cassation appeals, and private complaints in areas of responsibility.

 

2. Organizes: 

work to ensure socio-political stability, interethnic and interfaith harmony, support and development of civil society institutions and non-governmental organizations, and enhance competitiveness and the information space;
- work to provide high-quality cultural services;
- work to implement state policy in the fields of science, preschool, secondary, technical and vocational, inclusive, and supplementary education;
- work to develop physical education and sports, and to attract the population to physical education and sports;
- work to protect the rights and legitimate interests of young people, to involve them in the socio-economic and socio-political life of the country, and to foster a sense of Kazakhstani patriotism in young people;
- work to study the processes taking place in the sphere of realization of citizens' rights to freedom of religious belief and the activities of religious associations, spiritual educational organizations, and missionaries;
- work to develop the state and other languages, create a tolerant linguistic environment, and implement state policy in the field of propaganda and the use of state symbols.

3. Coordinates:
- interaction between territorial bodies in the implementation of programs and comprehensive activities in the areas of domestic policy (social development), culture, information, education, science, sports, youth policy, religion, and language development;
- interaction with quasi-public sector organizations, business entities, international and public organizations, foundations, and other enterprises within the scope of assigned powers.


4. Manages:
- the Secretariat of the Assembly of the People of Kazakhstan of Kostanay Region;
- structural subdivisions of the Akimat implementing work in the areas of domestic policy (social development), culture, information, education, science, sports, youth policy, religion, and language development;
- oversees the work of the regional conscription commission.


5. Heads territorial consultative and coordinating councils and commissions (within the scope of assigned powers).

items.text: 确保：

careerHistoryBlocksZh.text: 及时、高质量和全面实施科斯塔奈州国内政策（社会发展）、文化、信息、教育、科学、体育、青年政策、宗教和语言发展领域的国家政策和地区计划；
careerHistoryBlocksZh.sourceText: the timely, high-quality, and complete implementation of state policy and regional programs in the areas of domestic policy (social development), culture, information, education, science, sports, youth policy, religion, and language development in the Kostanay region;

careerHistoryBlocksZh.text: - 及时、高质量和全面执行哈萨克斯坦共和国总统、哈萨克斯坦共和国总理、哈萨克斯坦共和国总统办公厅、哈萨克斯坦共和国国务资政、哈萨克斯坦共和国政府办公厅的法令和指示以及科斯塔奈州行政长官和行政公署的法令和指示；
careerHistoryBlocksZh.sourceText: - the timely, high-quality, and complete implementation of acts and instructions of the President of the Republic of Kazakhstan, the Prime Minister of the Republic of Kazakhstan, the Administration of the President of the Republic of Kazakhstan, the State Counselor of the Republic of Kazakhstan, the Executive Office of the Government of the Republic of Kazakhstan, and acts and instructions of the Akim and Akimat of Kostanay region;

careerHistoryBlocksZh.text: - 与哈萨克斯坦共和国总统办公厅、哈萨克斯坦共和国政府执行办公室、哈萨克斯坦共和国中央政府机构及其领土部门以及其他政府机构和机构进行互动；
careerHistoryBlocksZh.sourceText: - interaction with the Administration of the President of the Republic of Kazakhstan, the Executive Office of the Government of the Republic of Kazakhstan, central government bodies of the Republic of Kazakhstan and their territorial divisions, and other government bodies and institutions;

careerHistoryBlocksZh.text: - 协调责任领域的法律草案、政府法令、总理命令、总统法案、上诉、撤销原判上诉和私人投诉。
careerHistoryBlocksZh.sourceText: - coordination of draft laws, government decrees, orders of the Prime Minister, acts of the President, appeals, cassation appeals, and private complaints in areas of responsibility.

careerHistoryBlocksZh.text: 2. 组织：
careerHistoryBlocksZh.sourceText: 2. Organizes:

careerHistoryBlocksZh.text: 努力确保社会政治稳定、种族间和宗教间和谐、民间社会机构和非政府组织的支持和发展，并增强竞争力和信息空间；
careerHistoryBlocksZh.sourceText: work to ensure socio-political stability, interethnic and interfaith harmony, support and development of civil society institutions and non-governmental organizations, and enhance competitiveness and the information space;

careerHistoryBlocksZh.text: ——努力提供优质文化服务；
careerHistoryBlocksZh.sourceText: - work to provide high-quality cultural services;

careerHistoryBlocksZh.text: - 努力执行科学、学前、中等、技术和职业、包容性和补充教育领域的国家政策；
careerHistoryBlocksZh.sourceText: - work to implement state policy in the fields of science, preschool, secondary, technical and vocational, inclusive, and supplementary education;

careerHistoryBlocksZh.text: ——大力发展体育事业，吸引群众参加体育运动；
careerHistoryBlocksZh.sourceText: - work to develop physical education and sports, and to attract the population to physical education and sports;

careerHistoryBlocksZh.text: - 努力保护年轻人的权利和合法利益，让他们参与国家的社会经济和社会政治生活，并在年轻人中培养哈萨克斯坦的爱国主义意识；
careerHistoryBlocksZh.sourceText: - work to protect the rights and legitimate interests of young people, to involve them in the socio-economic and socio-political life of the country, and to foster a sense of Kazakhstani patriotism in young people;

careerHistoryBlocksZh.text: - 努力研究公民宗教信仰自由权利的实现过程以及宗教协会、精神教育组织和传教士的活动；
careerHistoryBlocksZh.sourceText: - work to study the processes taking place in the sphere of realization of citizens' rights to freedom of religious belief and the activities of religious associations, spiritual educational organizations, and missionaries;

careerHistoryBlocksZh.text: - 努力发展国家语言和其他语言，创造宽容的语言环境，并在宣传和使用国家标志方面落实国家政策。
careerHistoryBlocksZh.sourceText: - work to develop the state and other languages, create a tolerant linguistic environment, and implement state policy in the field of propaganda and the use of state symbols.

careerHistoryBlocksZh.text: 3、坐标：
careerHistoryBlocksZh.sourceText: 3. Coordinates:

careerHistoryBlocksZh.text: - 领土机构之间在执行国内政策（社会发展）、文化、信息、教育、科学、体育、青年政策、宗教和语言发展领域的方案和综合活动方面的互动；
careerHistoryBlocksZh.sourceText: - interaction between territorial bodies in the implementation of programs and comprehensive activities in the areas of domestic policy (social development), culture, information, education, science, sports, youth policy, religion, and language development;

careerHistoryBlocksZh.text: - 在授权范围内与准公共部门组织、商业实体、国际和公共组织、基金会和其他企业进行互动。
careerHistoryBlocksZh.sourceText: - interaction with quasi-public sector organizations, business entities, international and public organizations, foundations, and other enterprises within the scope of assigned powers.

careerHistoryBlocksZh.text: 4. 管理：
careerHistoryBlocksZh.sourceText: 4. Manages:

careerHistoryBlocksZh.text: - 哈萨克斯坦科斯塔奈州人民大会秘书处；
careerHistoryBlocksZh.sourceText: - the Secretariat of the Assembly of the People of Kazakhstan of Kostanay Region;

careerHistoryBlocksZh.text: - 行政机关的结构性分支机构，负责国内政策（社会发展）、文化、信息、教育、科学、体育、青年政策、宗教和语言发展领域的工作；
careerHistoryBlocksZh.sourceText: - structural subdivisions of the Akimat implementing work in the areas of domestic policy (social development), culture, information, education, science, sports, youth policy, religion, and language development;

careerHistoryBlocksZh.text: - 监督地区征兵委员会的工作。
careerHistoryBlocksZh.sourceText: - oversees the work of the regional conscription commission.

careerHistoryBlocksZh.text: 5. 领导地方协商和协调理事会和委员会（在指定的权力范围内）。
careerHistoryBlocksZh.sourceText: 5. Heads territorial consultative and coordinating councils and commissions (within the scope of assigned powers).

people.generalInfoZh:
Narymbetov Bakytzhan Haberovich，1986年8月4日出生于乌拉尔斯克市，具有高等教育学历。
毕业于哈萨克斯坦阿尔法拉比国立大学政治学专业，社会科学硕士。

确保：
及时、高质量和全面实施科斯塔奈州国内政策（社会发展）、文化、信息、教育、科学、体育、青年政策、宗教和语言发展领域的国家政策和地区计划；
- 及时、高质量和全面执行哈萨克斯坦共和国总统、哈萨克斯坦共和国总理、哈萨克斯坦共和国总统办公厅、哈萨克斯坦共和国国务资政、哈萨克斯坦共和国政府办公厅的法令和指示以及科斯塔奈州行政长官和行政公署的法令和指示；
- 与哈萨克斯坦共和国总统办公厅、哈萨克斯坦共和国政府执行办公室、哈萨克斯坦共和国中央政府机构及其领土部门以及其他政府机构和机构进行互动；
- 协调责任领域的法律草案、政府法令、总理命令、总统法案、上诉、撤销原判上诉和私人投诉。
2. 组织：
努力确保社会政治稳定、种族间和宗教间和谐、民间社会机构和非政府组织的支持和发展，并增强竞争力和信息空间；
——努力提供优质文化服务；
- 努力执行科学、学前、中等、技术和职业、包容性和补充教育领域的国家政策；
——大力发展体育事业，吸引群众参加体育运动；
- 努力保护年轻人的权利和合法利益，让他们参与国家的社会经济和社会政治生活，并在年轻人中培养哈萨克斯坦的爱国主义意识；
- 努力研究公民宗教信仰自由权利的实现过程以及宗教协会、精神教育组织和传教士的活动；
- 努力发展国家语言和其他语言，创造宽容的语言环境，并在宣传和使用国家标志方面落实国家政策。
3、坐标：
- 领土机构之间在执行国内政策（社会发展）、文化、信息、教育、科学、体育、青年政策、宗教和语言发展领域的方案和综合活动方面的互动；
- 在授权范围内与准公共部门组织、商业实体、国际和公共组织、基金会和其他企业进行互动。
4. 管理：
- 哈萨克斯坦科斯塔奈州人民大会秘书处；
- 行政机关的结构性分支机构，负责国内政策（社会发展）、文化、信息、教育、科学、体育、青年政策、宗教和语言发展领域的工作；
- 监督地区征兵委员会的工作。
5. 领导地方协商和协调理事会和委员会（在指定的权力范围内）。

people.generalInfoHtml:
Tanzharikov Berik Kuanyshevich, born on December 28, 1990 in the Mendykarinsky district of the Kostanay region, has a higher education.
Graduated from the Eurasian National University named after L.N. Gumilyov, specializing in "construction", Master of Technical Sciences.
people.careerHistoryHtml:
He began his career in April 2011 as a site foreman at Fire Safeti Engineering LLP. Until July 2015, he worked as a construction site foreman, engineer, deputy director, and foreman in private construction companies in Astana, including the BI Group holding.
From July 2015 to October 2019, he held the position of deputy, then head of the department of state architectural and construction control of the Akimat of Kostanay region.
From October 2019 to September 2023 - head of the department of construction, architecture and urban development of the Akimat of Kostanay region

From September 2023 to October 2024 - akim of Kostanay district of Kostanay region.
From October 2024 to the present - deputy akim of Kostanay region.

 

1. Ensures:
- the timely, high-quality, and complete implementation of state policy and regional programs in the areas of construction, housing and utilities, energy, water supply, heat supply, gas supply, landscaping and landscaping, industry, transport, highways, telecommunications, urban planning, architecture, architectural and construction supervision in the Kostanay region, fisheries, natural resources and nature management, and water use and protection;
- the timely, high-quality, and complete implementation of acts and instructions of the President of the Republic of Kazakhstan, the Prime Minister of the Republic of Kazakhstan, the Administration of the President of the Republic of Kazakhstan, the State Advisor of the Republic of Kazakhstan, the Executive Office of the Government of the Republic of Kazakhstan, and acts and instructions of the Akim and Akimat of Kostanay Region;
- interaction with the Executive Office of the President of the Republic of Kazakhstan, the Executive Office of the Government of the Republic of Kazakhstan, the central government bodies of the Republic of Kazakhstan and their territorial divisions, and other government bodies and institutions;
- Coordination of draft laws, government decrees, orders of the Prime Minister, presidential acts, appeals, cassation appeals, and private complaints in areas of responsibility.

2. Organizes:
- Implementation of state policy in construction, architecture, and urban planning;
- Infrastructure development in housing and utilities, settlements, industrial facilities, telecommunications networks, public amenities, landscaping, and waste management;
- Energy, heat, water, and gas supply;
- Regulation, coordination, and oversight of a unified policy in passenger transport and the operation of highways;
- Implementation of state architectural and construction control and supervision of the quality of construction projects, and state control in the management of the housing stock;
- work to preserve the biological diversity of flora and fauna, ensure forest protection, improve environmental quality, efficiently use and protect water bodies, land reclamation, and irrigation;
- work on the prevention and response to natural and man-made emergencies.

3. Coordinates:
- interaction between territorial agencies in the implementation of programs and integrated measures in the areas of construction, housing and utilities, energy, water supply, heat supply, gas supply, landscaping and greening, industry, transport, highways, telecommunications, urban planning, architecture, architectural and construction supervision, fisheries, natural resources and environmental management, and water use and protection;
- interaction with quasi-public sector organizations, business entities, international and public organizations, foundations, and other enterprises within the scope of assigned powers;
- interdepartmental cooperation in the prevention and response to natural and man-made emergencies.

4. Manages:
- structural divisions of the Akimat implementing work in the areas of construction, housing and utilities, energy, water supply, heat supply, gas supply, landscaping and landscaping, industry, transport, highways, telecommunications, urban planning, architecture, architectural and construction supervision, fisheries, natural resources and environmental management, and water use and protection.

5. Heads territorial advisory and coordinating councils and commissions (within the scope of assigned powers).

people.generalInfoZh:
Tanzharikov Berik Kuanyshevich，1990年12月28日出生于科斯塔奈州门迪卡拉区，具有高等教育学历。
毕业于以 L.N. 命名的欧亚国立大学。古米廖夫，专业为“建筑”，技术科学硕士。
people.careerHistoryZh:
他于2011年4月开始职业生涯，在 Fire Safeti Engineering LLP 担任施工现场工长。2015年7月前，他在阿斯塔纳的私营建筑公司工作，包括 BI Group 控股公司，历任施工现场工长、工程师、副主任和工长。
2015年7月至2019年10月，担任科斯塔奈州行政机关国家建筑和建设控制部副部长、部长。
2019年10月至2023年9月 - 科斯塔奈州行政机关建设、建筑和城市发展部门负责人
2023 年 9 月至 2024 年 10 月 - 科斯塔奈州科斯塔奈县行政长官。
2024年10月至今 - 科斯塔奈州副部长。
1. 确保：
- 及时、高质量、全面实施建筑、住房和公用事业、能源、供水、供热、供气、园林绿化、工业、交通、公路、电信、城市规划、建筑、科斯塔奈地区建筑和施工监理、渔业、自然资源和自然管理、水资源利用和保护等领域的国家政策和区域计划；
- 及时、高质量和全面执行哈萨克斯坦共和国总统、哈萨克斯坦共和国总理、哈萨克斯坦共和国总统办公厅、哈萨克斯坦共和国国家顾问、哈萨克斯坦共和国政府办公厅的法令和指示，以及科斯塔奈州长官和长官的法令和指示；
- 与哈萨克斯坦共和国总统办公厅、哈萨克斯坦共和国政府办公厅、哈萨克斯坦共和国中央政府机构及其领土部门以及其他政府机构和机构进行互动；
- 协调责任领域的法律草案、政府法令、总理命令、总统令、上诉、撤销原判上诉和私人投诉。
2. 组织：
- 执行国家在建设、建筑和城市规划方面的政策；
- 住房和公用事业、住区、工业设施、电信网络、公共设施、景观美化和废物管理方面的基础设施开发；
- 能源、热力、水和燃气供应；
- 制定、协调和监督客运和公路运营的统一政策；
- 实施国家建筑和施工控制以及对建设项目质量的监督，以及国家对住房存量管理的控制；
- 努力保护动植物生物多样性，确保森林保护，改善环境质量，有效利用和保护水体，开垦和灌溉；
- 致力于预防和应对自然和人为紧急情况。
3、坐标：
- 领土机构之间在执行建筑、住房和公用事业、能源、供水、供热、供气、景观和绿化、工业、交通、公路、电信、城市规划、建筑、建筑和施工监督、渔业、自然资源和环境管理以及用水和保护等领域的方案和综合措施方面的互动；
- 在授权范围内与准公共部门组织、商业实体、国际和公共组织、基金会和其他企业进行互动；
- 预防和应对自然和人为紧急情况的部门间合作。
4. 管理：
- 行政机关的结构部门，在建筑、住房和公用事业、能源、供水、供热、供气、园林绿化和景观美化、工业、交通、公路、电信、城市规划、建筑、建筑和施工监督、渔业、自然资源和环境管理以及水的利用和保护等领域开展工作。
5. 领导地区咨询和协调理事会和委员会（在指定的权力范围内）。

- 领土机构之间在执行建筑、住房和公用事业、能源、供水、供热、供气、景观和绿化、工业、交通、公路、电信、城市规划、建筑、建筑和施工监督、渔业、自然资源和环境管理以及用水和保护等领域的方案和综合措施方面的互动；

- 预防和应对自然和人为紧急情况的部门间合作。
4. 管理：
- 行政机关的结构部门，在建筑、住房和公用事业、能源、供水、供热、供气、园林绿化和景观美化、工业、交通、公路、电信、城市规划、建筑、建筑和施工监督、渔业、自然资源和环境管理以及水的利用和保护等领域开展工作。
5. 领导地区咨询和协调理事会和委员会（在指定的权力范围内）。

穆拉特·桑迪巴耶夫（Murat Sandybayev）1988年12月15日出生于科斯塔奈州乌宗科尔地区。
他有两个文凭。
people.careerHistoryZh:
2010年8月4日 | 2012年12月31日 | 科斯塔奈州市长办公室信息技术和公共服务监测部门计算机支持专家
2013年1月3日 | 2013年1月28日 | 科斯塔奈州市长办公室组织和控制部门代理首席专家
2013年1月29日 | 2015年3月10日 | 科斯塔奈州市长办公室首席专家、组织和控制单位
2015年3月11日 | 2015年6月28日 | 科斯塔奈州市长办公室组织和控制股首席督察
2015年6月29日 | 2015年11月4日 | 科斯塔奈州市长办公室组织和控制部门负责人
2015年11月5日 | 2016年10月25日 | 科斯塔奈州市长助理
2016年10月26日 | 2018年4月9日 | 科斯塔奈州费多罗夫斯基区副区长
2018年4月10日 | 2020年11月17日 | 科斯塔奈州市长办公室副主任
2020年11月18日 | 2022年2月27日 | 科斯塔奈州乌尊科尔区区长
2022年7月28日 | 至今 | 科斯塔奈州市长办公室主任
1. 确保：
- 及时、高质量、全面实施数字化、信息化、信息安全、档案、地方执行机构提供公共服务、科斯塔奈州电子政务等领域的国家政策和地区计划，以及科斯塔奈州州长办公室的运作；
- 及时、高质量和全面执行哈萨克斯坦共和国总统、哈萨克斯坦共和国总理、哈萨克斯坦共和国总统办公厅、哈萨克斯坦共和国国家顾问、哈萨克斯坦共和国政府办公厅的法令和指示，以及科斯塔奈州长官和长官的法令和指示；
- 与哈萨克斯坦共和国总统办公厅、哈萨克斯坦共和国政府办公室、哈萨克斯坦共和国中央政府机构及其领土部门以及其他政府机构和机构进行互动；
- 协调责任领域的法律草案、政府法令、总理命令、总统法令、上诉、撤销原判上诉和私人投诉。
2. 组织：
- 努力确保在关键经济部门发展和实施现代信息和通信技术、提供高质量公共服务以及发展项目管理的条件；
- 行政长官 结构部门的工作确保 科斯塔奈 地区 行政长官办公室的稳定运作。
3、坐标：
- 领土机构在实施数字化、信息化、信息安全、档案和提供公共服务领域的方案和综合措施方面的互动；
- 在授权范围内与准公共部门组织、商业实体、国际和公共组织、基金会和其他企业进行互动。
4. 管理：
- 行政长官的结构部门确保 行政长官办公室以及数字化、信息化、信息安全、归档和提供公共服务领域工作的稳定运作。
5. 领导地区咨询和协调理事会和委员会（在指定权力的框架内）。

people.generalInfoHtml: Sandybaev Murat Mirtaevich was born in 1988. Baitursynova A., Kostanay State University, programmer of information systems. Master of Economics and Business Administration
people.careerHistoryHtml:
He began his career in 2010 as a specialist in computer support for the department of information technology and monitoring of public services of the akim of the Kostanai region.

In 2013-2015, he worked as a chief specialist, chief inspector and head of the department of organizational and control work of the apparatus of akim of Kostanai region.

From 2015 to 2016, he was an assistant to the akim of the Kostanai region.

In November 2016, he was appointed deputy akim of the Fedorovsky district.

In April 2018, he was appointed deputy chief of staff of the akim of the Kostanai region

people.name: Kadambaeva Dina Serikbaevna
people.position: Head of the state legal Department
people.positionZh: 国家法律事务处负责人
people.workScopeZh: 官方页面未列出单独工作范围。
people.generalInfoHtml:
In 1996, she graduated from Al-Farabi Kazakh State University (Almaty) with a degree in Jurisprudence.
In 2021, she graduated from the South Ural State Humanitarian and Pedagogical University (Chelyabinsk) with a degree in Psychology and Education.
people.careerHistoryHtml:
- Since September 1996, she worked in the Kostanay City Prosecutor's Office, as a prosecutor and senior prosecutor in the Kostanay City Prosecutor's Office;
- Since 2000, she worked in the Kostanay Regional Prosecutor's Office in the area of ​​civil-judicial supervision and enforcement proceedings, as a prosecutor and senior prosecutor in the department;
- Since 2017, she has served as senior assistant to the regional prosecutor for organizational and control work in the Kostanay Regional Prosecutor's Office;
- Since May 2018, she has served as senior assistant to the regional prosecutor and head of human resources in the Kostanay Regional Prosecutor's Office;
- Since March 2024, she has served as senior assistant to the regional prosecutor for handling appeals and paperwork in the Kostanay Regional Prosecutor's Office;
- Since September 22, 2025, she has served as head of the state and legal department of the Akim's Office of Kostanay Region.

1996年，她毕业于法拉比哈萨克斯坦国立大学（阿拉木图），获得法学学位。
2021年，她毕业于南乌拉尔国立人道主义师范大学（车里雅宾斯克），获得心理学和教育学位。
- 1996年9月起在科斯塔奈市检察官办公室工作，担任科斯塔奈市检察官办公室检察官、高级检察官；
- 自2000年以来，她在科斯塔奈州检察官办公室从事民事司法监督和执行程序领域的工作，担任该部门的检察官和高级检察官；
- 自2017年起，她在科斯塔奈州检察官办公室担任地区检察官高级助理，负责组织和控制工作；
- 自2018年5月起，担任科斯塔奈州检察官办公室地区检察官高级助理兼人力资源主管；
- 自2024年3月起，她担任地区检察官高级助理，负责处理科斯塔奈州检察官办公室的上诉和文书工作；
- 自2025年9月22日起，她担任科斯塔奈州州长办公室国家和法律部门负责人。
